T.data_reference: davis2021transcriptomic; Methods (Ch. 2): "All recordings were performed at room temperature" (value not stated; 22 degC assumed); p. 215: neurons died above 30 degC

Cai.data_reference: definitional; SN_simple Cai_init (hagiwara1981calcium; used when unconnected)

A_ER.data_reference: definitional; the soma ER membrane area 86.01 um^2 of a sphere of volume c_ER Vol (used when unconnected; in a soma it comes from the Ca handling through the ER_membrane_area port)

rho_RyR.data_reference: definitional; chosen so that k_RyR = A rho k_RyR_single (1e-18 m3/um3) reproduces the previous k_RyR = 1.5e-13 m3_per_s (to_be_identified) with A = 86.01 um^2 (the soma ER membrane area) and k_RyR_single = 3.023 um3_per_s; a density for calibration through k_RyR_single

k_RyR_single.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; per-channel flux coefficient i/(2 F dCa) for a ~0.35 pA unitary Ca current at a 0.6 mM ER-cytosol difference = 3.02 um^3/s

Q10_RyR.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; conventional gating Q10 (no effect while T_ref = T)

T_ref_RyR.data_reference: definitional; equal to the model temperature, so kinetics are unscaled; to be set to the source's recording temperature on review
